sourceText:
Courgette Chutney
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 8:40pm

Ingredients




3 mediums Courgette
1 Onions
teaspoon Hing
teaspoon Tamcon
2 Green chillies

Preparation

1 Fry cut courgette, onions, and green chillies. Add turmeric, salt, cook on low flame for 5 to 10 minutes. Boil tamcon, add to mix above. Pulverize the whole thing in blender. 2 Seasoning: Thalshi Kottify with mustard seeds, urad dal.
